size.evidence: network_game_server_get_client_machine_at_index returns server+0x43c+index*0x10; network_game_server_get_machine_connection scans four slots at that stride

fields.name: connection
fields.evidence: network_game_server_get_client_machine_at_address asserts server->client_machines[i].connection and passes slot dword +0x00 to network_connection_get_address

fields.name: last_received_update_sequence_number
fields.evidence: network_game_server_dump logs dword slot+0x04 with the exact label last_received_update_sequence_number

fields.name: stall_start_time
fields.evidence: network_game_server_dump logs dword slot+0x08 with the exact label stall_start_time

fields.name: machine_index
fields.evidence: network_game_server_get_machine_connection compares signed word at slot+0x0c with the live machine index; address lookup range-checks the same word

fields.name: flags
fields.evidence: network_game_server_dump logs word slot+0x0e with the exact label flags; network_game_server_all_machines_have_loaded tests bit 3

notes: This 0x10-byte server connection slot is distinct from the 0x44-byte copied network_machine_record_t used inside the network game blob.
